165:t_1:92.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$マリーダ$$... Why did it have to end up like that...)

165:t_1:94.en:
$$シャア$$
「Is this a good time? I'll intrude for a moment.」

165:t_1:96.en:
$$シャア$$
「There's no need to be so tense. It was a short time, but we fought side by side.」

165:t_1:97.en:
$$シャア$$
「Or do you not feel like talking to a former enemy?」

165:t_1:98.en:
$$バナージ$$
「No... I'd like to think I understand that you had your reasons, too.」

165:t_1:99.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That doesn't mean I'm willing to accept that you started a war, though.」

165:t_1:100.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's fine. Hold on to that sensibility.」

165:t_1:101.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Strange... It's similar to my exchange with $$フル・フロンタル$$ at $$パラオ$$, yet the impression is completely different...)

165:t_1:102.en:
$$バナージ$$
(So this is... the true $$赤い彗星$$...)

165:t_1:103.en:
$$シャア$$
「Are you comparing me with $$フル・フロンタル$$?」

165:t_1:105.en:
$$シャア$$
「There's no need to hide it. Even among $c, you are one of the few people who met him in person.」

165:t_1:106.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now... there is no point in talking about who is real and who is fake.」

165:t_1:107.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that... because he became the Leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$?」

165:t_1:108.en:
$$シャア$$
「Exactly. If that man truly becomes a vessel that gathers the Spacenoids' feelings, as he says, then the name of the $$赤い彗星$$ will suit him.」

165:t_1:109.en:
$$シャア$$
「Not that I think I could ever come to like him.」

165:t_1:110.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...What did you come to me for...?」

165:t_1:111.en:
$$シャア$$
「I came because I wanted to tell you about $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

165:t_1:113.en:
$$シャア$$
「...The idea of the enhanced human and the history of cloning technology go back even further than the 《$$一年戦争$$》...」

165:t_1:114.en:
$$シャア$$
「Back then $$ジオン$$... no, the Republic, preparing for the coming war with the $$地球連邦$$, tried to solve both its lack of troops and the training of excellent soldiers.」

165:t_1:115.en:
$$シャア$$
「That was the first enhanced human project in history, and the clones that served as base subjects, born from superior genes, were called the Proto $$プル$$ Series.」

165:t_1:116.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$プル$$...? Don't tell me...」

165:t_1:117.en:
$$シャア$$
「Number 12 of them... Proto $$プルトゥエルブ$$ is none other than $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

165:t_1:119.en:
$$シャア$$
「They grew steadily, and it was expected that within a few years they would become excellent $$ジオン$$ soldiers...」

165:t_1:120.en:
$$シャア$$
「But history moved faster than anyone imagined, and the $$一年戦争$$ began much sooner than expected... By then they were far too young to stand on a battlefield.」

165:t_1:121.en:
$$シャア$$
「In return, they were granted a power beyond mere physical enhancement...」

165:t_1:122.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$ abilities...」

165:t_1:123.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's right. And at the burning $$ア・バオア・クー$$, they saw the White Devil destroying their comrades' units one after another.」

165:t_1:124.en:
$$シャア$$
「To them, it must have been etched into memory as the hated enemy that sent them down a harsh path of fate.」

165:t_1:125.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So that's... a $$ガンダム$$...」

165:t_1:126.en:
$$シャア$$
「After that, even though I am the foremost authority on $$ニュータイプ$$ research, my subordinates could not trace where each of them went.」

165:t_1:127.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But...! But $$マリーダ$$ is still in the middle of fighting even now... and not in a way she wants!」

165:t_1:128.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To defeat the $$ガンダム$$!」

165:t_1:129.en:
$$シャア$$
「And you are riding that $$ガンダム$$.」

165:t_1:131.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I heard from $$ミネバ$$ how you came to ride the $$ユニコーン$$. And in the $$時獄戦役$$, I was able to judge what kind of person you are with my own eyes.」

165:t_1:132.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you trying to say?」

165:t_1:133.en:
$$シャア$$
「I thought you had resolve, but it seems I overestimated you.」

165:t_1:134.en:
$$シャア$$
「As you are now, it would be impossible even to ask you for the Box's next coordinates.」

165:t_1:135.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you after the Box too?」

165:t_1:136.en:
$$シャア$$
「If pointless fighting is going to break out over it, I even considered burying it forever...」

165:t_1:137.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I hear that $$リディ・マーセナス$$ called it a prayer that turns into a curse.」

165:t_1:139.en:
$$シャア$$
「A wish for the future that was raised with the birth of the $$宇宙世紀$$... Don't you want to know it?」

165:t_1:141.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's too much for you as you are now, then...」

165:t_1:142.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I want you to think about it once more. That you are the key to the Box... that you stand together with humanity's possibilities...」

165:t_1:143.en:
$$シャア$$
「And what it means that it is a $$ガンダム$$.」

165:t_1:146.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ブライト$$. To think the captain himself would come.」

165:t_1:147.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So you were here, $$シャア$$.」

165:t_1:148.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't ask my reason. Not that it isn't probably the same as yours.」

165:t_1:149.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So we've both grown old, then.」

165:t_1:150.en:
$$シャア$$
「Unlike you, who's doing a proper job as a parent, I do nothing but take detours.」

165:t_1:151.en:
$$シャア$$
「My business is done. I'll leave the rest to you.」

165:t_1:155.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Taking my turn after the $$赤い彗星$$ is a bit nerve-racking.」

165:t_1:156.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...I'd like to talk with you. May I, $$バナージ$$?」

165:t_1:157.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is it about the Box's coordinates...?」

165:t_1:159.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Expecting anything from me is pointless... I'm already...」

165:t_1:160.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A guy like me... riding a $$ガンダム$$ and making $$マリーダ$$ suffer...」

165:t_1:161.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Besides, even getting on the $$ユニコーン$$ was more or less an accident... And I...」

165:t_1:164.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It may have been chance that there was a $$ガンダム$$ in front of you then.」

165:t_1:165.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The ones who have ridden $$ガンダム$$s until now... $$アムロ$$, $$カミーユ$$, all of them were the same.」

165:t_1:166.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But whether to ride a $$ガンダム$$ was something you decided yourself, so it can't be chance. ...Am I wrong?」

165:t_1:168.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Try to remember what made you resolve to ride the $$ガンダム$$ then.」

165:t_1:171.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, Captain $$ブライト$$. I...」

ア・バオア・クー.evidence: Official English spelling of the final battle site of the One Year War (Mobile Suit Gundam); no glossary entry exists.

uncertain: 165:t_1:114: ジオン公国…いや、共和国 rendered 'Back then $$ジオン$$... no, the Republic' (bare ジオン token) to fit 3 lines; the Principality/Republic correction is lost in English (full tokens did not fit).
165:t_1:126: ニュータイプ研究の第一人者である私の部下 parsed as Char being the foremost authority ('even though I am...'); could instead describe the subordinates.
165:t_1:124: relative clause 過酷な運命を歩まされる事となった憎むべき敵 read as the enemy that sent them down a harsh path of fate.
165:t_1:121: その代わり rendered 'In return' (compensation for being too young to fight).
165:t_1:123: 白い悪魔 = 'White Devil' (no glossary entry); ア・バオア・クー proposed as new name token 'A Baoa Qu'.
165:t_1:169: Banagher's thought (…オードリー…) uses $$オードリー$$ (bare Audrey).
165:t_1:157: Banagher guesses Bright wants the Box's coordinates (Char had asked the same), rendered as a question about the Box's coordinates.
